meta_title: Accept Crypto Payments in India | Dynopay Gateway
meta_description: Accept Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT and 10+ cryptocurrencies in India. Non-custodial, 1.5% flat fee, no monthly charges. Start accepting crypto today.
h1: Accept crypto payments in India with a non-custodial gateway
subheading: Receive Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT, and 10+ cryptocurrencies directly to your wallet. No custody risk, flat 1.5% fee, live in under 10 minutes.
intro_paragraph: Indian businesses can now accept cryptocurrency payments without giving up control of their funds. Dynopay is a non-custodial payment gateway that sends customer payments directly to your wallet—we never hold your money. You get access to 12 cryptocurrencies across 6 blockchains, pay a transparent 1.5% platform fee with no monthly charges, and go live in under 10 minutes. Whether your customers pay in Bitcoin, USDT, or Solana, you maintain full custody while converting to INR through your preferred exchange.

features.title: You control your funds always
features.description: Payments land directly in your wallet. Dynopay never holds, freezes, or controls your cryptocurrency. You decide when and how to convert to INR or hold long-term.

features.title: 1.5% flat fee, no surprises
features.description: Pay 1.5% per successful transaction plus a small fixed component ($1 for orders under $1000). No setup fees, no monthly fees, no hidden charges.

features.title: 12 cryptocurrencies, 6 blockchains supported
features.description: Accept Bitcoin, Ethereum, Litecoin, USDT on three networks, USDC, RLUSD, Solana, XRP, Dogecoin, Tron, Polygon, and Bitcoin Cash from customers worldwide.

how_it_works: Sign up with your email, verify your account, and create your company profile on Dynopay.
Add your cryptocurrency wallet address where you want to receive payments—one wallet to start.
Generate a payment link or embed the checkout widget on your website and start accepting payments.

faqs.question: Which cryptocurrencies can I accept with Dynopay in India?
faqs.answer: You can accept Bitcoin, Litecoin, Bitcoin Cash, Dogecoin, Ethereum, USDT on ERC20, TRC20 and Polygon networks, USDC on Ethereum, RLUSD on Ethereum and XRP Ledger, MATIC, Tron, Solana, and XRP. That's 12 different cryptocurrencies across 6 major blockchains.

faqs.question: Does Dynopay hold my cryptocurrency payments?
faqs.answer: No. Dynopay is non-custodial. Every payment goes directly from your customer to your wallet. You maintain full control and custody of your funds at all times. Dynopay never holds, accesses, or controls your cryptocurrency.

faqs.question: What are the fees to accept crypto payments?
faqs.answer: Dynopay charges a flat 1.5% platform fee on successful transactions, plus a small fixed fee: $1 for orders under $100, up to $1 for orders under $1000. No setup fees, no monthly fees, no withdrawal fees.

faqs.question: How long does it take to start accepting cryptocurrency?
faqs.answer: Under 10 minutes. Sign up, verify your email, create your company profile, add one payout wallet address, then generate a payment link or add the checkout widget to your site. You can accept your first payment immediately.

faqs.question: Can I convert crypto payments to INR?
faqs.answer: Dynopay sends cryptocurrency directly to your wallet. You can then transfer it to any Indian exchange that supports your chosen cryptocurrency and convert to INR according to their process and fees. Dynopay does not handle fiat conversion.

cta_headline: Start accepting crypto payments in 10 minutes
cta_body: Sign up now, add your wallet, and take your first cryptocurrency payment today. No monthly fees, full custody, transparent pricing.
